verdict.rationale: Meilisearch has no named sandbox or staging feature. However, it is a single dependency-free binary that can be installed locally via cURL, Homebrew, APT, or official Docker images described as 'for easy deployment and development', so a user can run an isolated throwaway instance away from production. A community user confirms a one-click Docker instance 'just worked', and a 14-day free cloud trial offers another separate environment. missing for 10: a documented first-party sandbox/staging environment concept, guidance or tooling for cloning or seeding test data from production, and any explicit test-environment workflow for AI agents (e.g., pointing the MCP server at a non-production instance).
